Lizard hermit's home


Setting

The Hermit Lizard’s home is a refuge with its own urgent problem: access to water. His bargain with Zak links a rescue, the orcs’ dam and the difficult route toward the Great Magician. [1, 2]

The expedition and the Hermit’s bargain

Estera introduces a lost Khadaganian official, who promises that his expedition can help Zak leave Gipath. Meeting Expedition commander instead leads to imprisonment and demands for information about a meteorite. Zak plays the ignorant swineherd, but the commander threatens torture. Hermit lizard offers escape on the condition that Zak later visit his home. Zak gives his word, receives the Ancient Claw for the traps on the approach and escapes. The Hermit explains that he had intended to negotiate with the armoured humans but changed his mind after seeing their treatment of Zak. Keeping the promise establishes trust where the expedition failed to do so. [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

Water for the lizards and the Great Magician

The Hermit needs the water diverted by the orcs restored. Zak raises their dam and blocks the diversion canal; in return the lizard locates the magician in a ravine in the Remote Mountains. This information joins the tunnel instructions from the Khadaganian report. Zak passes the ancient defences and reaches Tka Rik (Tka-Lithan Richti-Nik). Tka-Rik explains that his dragonet has watched Zak since his unusual arrival. Bound to Gipath by his duty as its Great Magician, he offers help with Zak’s memory in exchange for bringing him two surviving young Joons. The first journey will be to Ingos to find the girl. Zak must leave his Gipath companions behind. [8, 9, 2, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]
